sql: SELECT TOP 10 m.Market AS marketName, m.Id AS marketId FROM cso.TblCustom_Market m INNER JOIN cso.TblCustom_UserManagement u ON u.Market = m.Market WHERE u.StoreCode = @store AND (@excludeMarket IS NULL OR m.Market <> @excludeMarket) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR m.Market = @preferred) GROUP BY m.Id, m.Market HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT u.Id) >= @minUsers ORDER BY m.Id
